explorePosts.title: AlphaFold 3 & Generative AI: Mapping the Molecular Machinery of Life
explorePosts.summary: Google DeepMind and Isomorphic Labs introduce a unified diffusion architecture capable of predicting the joint 3D structures of proteins, DNA, RNA, and small-molecule ligands with atomic precision—transforming structural biology and rational drug design.

explorePosts.title: James Webb Space Telescope Detects Carbon-Bearing Molecules on Exoplanet K2-18 b
explorePosts.summary: Transmission spectroscopy from JWST's NIRISS and NIRSpec instruments reveals an abundance of methane and carbon dioxide in the habitable-zone atmosphere of sub-Neptune K2-18 b, 120 light-years away, pointing toward a candidate Hycean world.

explorePosts.title: Below the Surface-Code Threshold: Fault-Tolerant Quantum Error Correction
explorePosts.summary: Experimental physicists demonstrate logical qubit memories where scaling the surface-code distance exponentially suppresses logical error rates, crossing the critical threshold required for fault-tolerant quantum simulation.

explorePosts.title: CRISPR Prime Editing & Programmable RNA: Precision Gene Therapy Advances
explorePosts.summary: Next-generation prime editors rewrite pathogenic point mutations and insertions without requiring double-stranded DNA breaks, opening new clinical pathways for hereditary blood and metabolic disorders.

explorePosts.title: QUANTA 2026/2027 New Strategy: Interdisciplinary Research, Skill Verification & Digital Governance
explorePosts.summary: QUANTA Scientific Club unveils its 2026/2027 strategic roadmap at the University of Algiers 1: uniting 6 operational departments and 6 specialized scientific teams around weekly hands-on lab tracks, verified STEM skill badges, transparent KPI governance, and student-led research projects from concept to publication.

dailyQuotes.text: When young minds unite in a scientific club, they create an academy of curiosity that no textbook alone can provide.
dailyQuotes.author: QUANTA Scientific Club

dailyQuotes.text: In science, patience in repeating a delicate measurement ten times is the price of a single enduring discovery.
dailyQuotes.author: Prof. Aziz Sancar

dailyQuotes.text: In a spiral galaxy, the ratio of dark-to-light matter is about a factor of ten. That's probably a good number for the ratio of our ignorance to our knowledge.
dailyQuotes.author: Vera Rubin

dailyQuotes.text: Don't let anyone tell you that you aren't good enough to do astronomy or physics.
dailyQuotes.author: Vera Rubin

dailyQuotes.text: Indeed, I felt that the simple-mindedness of my own approach to stellar structure gave me an advantage.
dailyQuotes.author: Subrahmanyan Chandrasekhar

dailyQuotes.text: The pursuit of science is at its best when guided by a sense of beauty and proportion.
dailyQuotes.author: Subrahmanyan Chandrasekhar

dailyQuotes.text: When you cannot compute a trajectory by hand fast enough, you verify the differential equations yourself until the astronaut returns safely.
dailyQuotes.author: Katherine Johnson

dailyQuotes.text: Like what you do, and then you will do your best.
dailyQuotes.author: Katherine Johnson

dailyQuotes.text: By combining deep learning with the physical laws of protein folding, AI becomes an instrument of scientific discovery.
dailyQuotes.author: Demis Hassabis

dailyQuotes.text: If we want machines to truly help humanity, our AI systems must be grounded in human dignity, ethics, and scientific transparency.
dailyQuotes.author: Fei-Fei Li

dailyQuotes.text: Chirped pulse amplification lets us stretch a laser pulse in time, amplify it safely, and compress it into ultrashort bursts of unprecedented intensity.
dailyQuotes.author: Donna Strickland

dailyQuotes.text: Gravitational waves are not light—they are ripples in the fabric of spacetime itself, allowing us to hear the collision of black holes.
dailyQuotes.author: Kip S. Thorne

dailyQuotes.text: Mathematics is not an arbitrary game of symbols; it reaches down to the very bedrock of physical reality.
dailyQuotes.author: Sir Roger Penrose

dailyQuotes.text: The Periodic Table is not a mere catalog of elements; its gaps predicted the exact properties of gallium and germanium before anyone held them in a hand.
dailyQuotes.author: Dmitri Mendeleev

dailyQuotes.text: In chemical reactions, nothing is lost, nothing is created, everything is transformed.
dailyQuotes.author: Antoine Lavoisier

dailyQuotes.text: It is not the strongest of the species that survives, nor the most intelligent, but the one most responsive to change.
dailyQuotes.author: Natural Selection & Evolutionary Biology

dailyQuotes.text: If you know you are on the right track, if you have this inner knowledge, then nobody can turn you off... no matter what they say.
dailyQuotes.author: Barbara McClintock

dailyQuotes.text: Every great advance in science has issued from a new audacity of imagination disciplined by rigorous experiment.
dailyQuotes.author: John Dewey & Philosophy of Science

dailyQuotes.text: Nature is pleased with simplicity, and affects not the pomp of superfluous causes.
dailyQuotes.author: Sir Isaac Newton

dailyQuotes.text: When white sunlight passes through a glass prism, it is not stained by the glass—it is resolved into its constituent spectral colors.
dailyQuotes.author: Sir Isaac Newton

dailyQuotes.text: The planets move in ellipses with the Sun at one focus, sweeping out equal areas in equal times.
dailyQuotes.author: Johannes Kepler

dailyQuotes.text: At absolute zero, thermal motion reaches its quantum floor; temperature is the measure of microscopic kinetic energy.
dailyQuotes.author: Lord Kelvin (William Thomson)

dailyQuotes.text: Entropy is the logarithm of the number of microscopic configurations corresponding to a macroscopic state: S = k log W.
dailyQuotes.author: Ludwig Boltzmann

dailyQuotes.text: Radiowaves travel at the exact speed of light predicted by Maxwell's equations—proving that light itself is an electromagnetic wave.
dailyQuotes.author: Heinrich Hertz

dailyQuotes.text: X-rays reveal the hidden architecture of crystals and bones by passing through matter that blocks ordinary light.
dailyQuotes.author: Wilhelm Conrad Röntgen & Max von Laue

dailyQuotes.text: Every electron, photon, and matter particle exhibits both wave interference and localized particle impact.
dailyQuotes.author: Louis de Broglie

dailyQuotes.text: No two identical fermions can occupy the same quantum state simultaneously—the principle that gives stability to atoms and stars.
dailyQuotes.author: Wolfgang Pauli

dailyQuotes.text: Superconductivity and superfluidity show that quantum mechanics can manifest on a macroscopic scale visible to the naked eye.
dailyQuotes.author: Lev Landau & Pyotr Kapitsa

dailyQuotes.text: The double helix of DNA carries genetic information in the complementary pairing of its four chemical bases.
dailyQuotes.author: Molecular Biology & Genetics

dailyQuotes.text: A stored-program computer treats instructions and data in the same memory, unlocking universal scientific simulation.
dailyQuotes.author: John von Neumann

dailyQuotes.text: Fiber optics guide pulses of laser light across oceans through total internal reflection, connecting the world's scientists.
dailyQuotes.author: Charles K. Kao

dailyQuotes.text: Blue light-emitting diodes completed the white-light spectrum, bringing efficient solid-state illumination to the entire planet.
dailyQuotes.author: Isamu Akasaki, Hiroshi Amano & Shuji Nakamura

dailyQuotes.text: The cosmos is within us. We are a way for the universe to know itself.
dailyQuotes.author: Carl Sagan
